acceptance: The use_case cell of every review CSV holds the use case ID and rows within a tier are ordered by that ID, so grouped by vendor and then by name; the order test is rewritten to ID keys. (B10)
Use cases of two vendors with the same name give two rows under two IDs and are never merged. (B03)
The export, repeat, conflict, review, merge, input, headings, order and support tests use ID keys and pass, and a repeat on the same inputs gives identical files. (B01, B02, B04 to B09)
contract.md and README state that the use_case cell is the use case ID and that the order is by vendor then name, with no code change unless a name read is found. (B03, B10)
A new use case's review row has a proposed use_case_name cell through a Use Cases use_case_name row in the headings file, and the headings and export tests cover it. (B03)
